title: LLM vendor model audit
description: Snapshot of what OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and AWS Bedrock publish about their models: lineup, list pricing, deprecations, and billable endpoints. Written by the vendor-audit automation as audits/audit-MM-DD-YYYY.json and consumed by the llm-price-update skill (this repo) and the model-audit skill (finch). Every value must be read from the vendor pages listed in `sources`; nothing is filled from model memory.

generated_at.description: Run date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Consumers pick the latest audit by this field, not by filename.

previous_audit.description: Filename of the audit this run was diffed against to compute new_since_previous_audit. null for the first run.

sources.description: Every vendor page read during the run. Each provider needs at least a pricing and a deprecations source.

models.description: Every model on the vendor's pricing page plus every model on its deprecations page, whether or not we ship it.

endpoints.description: Every HTTP endpoint in the vendor API reference that consumes or produces tokens (chat, responses, messages, generateContent, interactions, embeddings, batch, count-tokens, ...). Empty for bedrock.

id.description: Canonical vendor API model id (gpt-5.6, claude-sonnet-5, gemini-3.5-flash, us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5). Never a marketing name.

aliases.description: Other API ids for the SAME version only: dated snapshots, -latest pointers, punctuation variants, same-version preview SKUs. A different version number or a -mini/-lite/-pro sibling is a separate model, never an alias.

status.description: active: on the pricing page, not on the deprecations page. preview: vendor labels it preview/experimental. deprecated: on the deprecations page with a future or unannounced sunset. shutdown: sunset_date is in the past or the API returns model_not_found. legacy: vendor still serves it but no longer recommends it and has not announced a sunset.

deprecated_date.description: Date the vendor announced the deprecation.

sunset_date.description: Vendor-announced shutdown date. null when none is announced; never inferred or estimated.

replaced_by.description: Vendor-recommended replacement id. Must be the id or alias of another model in the same provider.

ga_equivalent.description: For preview SKUs only: the GA id once the vendor ships it. null while the model is still preview-only or is not a preview.

pricing.description: Standard-tier list price in USD per 1M tokens (not cached, not batch, not promotional). Flat pricing is a single tier with up_to_tokens null. Prompt-length tiers are listed ascending and the last tier has up_to_tokens null.

promo_pricing.description: Time-limited introductory rate, if the vendor publishes one. Recorded for comments only; consumers encode the list price.

new_since_previous_audit.description: true when the id did not appear in previous_audit.

source.description: Vendor page the row was read from.

verified_by.description: Independent URLs that confirmed the row. Required to be non-empty when the model is new, its status changed, or a price moved by more than 20% since previous_audit.

up_to_tokens.description: Inclusive prompt-token ceiling for this tier; null means no ceiling.

ends_on.description: null when the vendor says 'at least through' without an end date.

path.description: Path template as documented, e.g. /v1/responses or /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent.

billable.description: async: tokens are billed when the job completes, not on this request (batch, background).

streaming_usage_event.description: SSE event that carries usage when streaming; null when the endpoint does not stream.

usage_location.description: JSON path of the usage object in the response, e.g. usage, usageMetadata.

introduced.description: Date the changelog says the endpoint shipped; null when unknown.
